description: Decision table for whether a human review covers a concept's current body (human_review: current or review) and how a changed concept is gated (gate: pass, block, or manual). The OKF Reviewer asserts it in src/features/review/reviewGate.test.ts; the analytics starter pack's validator (--review-changed) should assert the same cases. Hashes are SHA-256 of the body with CRLF normalized to LF. A deprecated concept is gated like a removed one: it is listed for manual impact review rather than stamped.
